intro: Zargh's Meats are a parcel of prime, raw cuts prepared by the orc Zargh at the Crossroads. Intended as a personal gift for Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar, they serve to introduce young Horde travelers to the regional wind rider network.

p: Prepared by Zargh, a butcher and hunter stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens, this package contains choice cuts of fresh meat destined for Gryshka, the innkeeper of the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Because fresh game spoils quickly under the dry heat of the savannas, Zargh entrusts the parcel to couriers bound for the Crossroads roost. There, Wind Rider Master Devrak arranges swift aerial transit atop a wyvern directly to Orgrimmar's Skytower, sparing travelers an arduous overland trek through Durotar.

While ostensibly an ordinary delivery of provisions, the shipment carries a fond personal sentiment. Upon receiving the bundle, Gryshka readily notes Zargh's knack for winning a lady's favor through quality game, eagerly preparing to sear the rare cuts for her inn's patrons and guests. For newly arrived orc and troll adventurers, carrying the meats provides an essential introduction to long-distance flight transit between Kalimdor's Horde settlements.
